faqs.a:
(a)
Any person who tenders to the city a dishonored check in payment of an amount of money
               that is due and owing to the city shall pay to the city a charge at a rate set forth
               in the administrative fee schedule, as approved by the city manager. This charge shall
               be to cover the additional accounting and procession costs incurred by the city in
               handling any check that is so dishonored.
(b)
As used in this section, the term "dishonor" means the process described in and governed
               by article 3 of the Uniform Commercial Code, as adopted by the state.
(Code 1981, § 2-192; Ord. No. 1813, § 1, 2-1-1982; Ord. No. 2019, § 1, 12-19-1983;
               Ord. No. 2750, § 1, 9-4-1990; Ord. No. 3237, § 3, 12-18-1995)
